Cpu.Flow.Title: CPU Particle Flow
Cpu.Flow.Summary: Fixed Spawn → Update → Draw phases, not Signal connections or a live trace. Inside a stage, use the normal CPU graph with Property and Signal inputs/outputs.
Cpu.Flow.SpawnDetail: Runs once when each particle is born. Set its initial position, velocity, color, size and life.
Cpu.Flow.UpdateDetail: Runs for each living particle on each simulation step. Read inputs, move particles and send outputs.
Cpu.Flow.DrawDetail: Draws the resulting particle snapshots. Select this stage to edit texture, blend mode and draw scale in the Inspector.
Cpu.Help.Container: Simulates a bounded CPU particle pool. Open Spawn and Update child graphs; ordinary CPU values and Signals run separately for each particle. Requires the matching updated SDK.
Cpu.Help.Stage: Edit this CPU particle stage as an ordinary graph. Spawn runs once at birth; Update runs once per simulation step. Attribute readers sample the stage input state; chain Signal setters to change attributes.
Cpu.Help.Attribute: Reads the current particle's attribute in a CPU Spawn/Update graph. Values belong to this particle, not a system-global sequence.
Cpu.Help.Set: On Signal arrival, writes the current particle attribute and continues through Then. Valid only in CPU Spawn/Update graphs.
Cpu.Help.Move: On Signal arrival, applies velocity += acceleration * stepDelta, then position += velocity * stepDelta. Connect the CPU Stage Event in Update.
Cpu.Help.Boundary: Adds a named ordinary CPU Property or Signal boundary to the container. Inputs are sampled consistently per step; outputs are bounded queued messages retaining system, node and particle identity. Input Signal belongs in Update; outer Properties require explicit LastById reduction.
Cpu.Help.Draw: Draws all live CPU particles as one batched billboard Sprite system. Set an explicit texture, Alpha/Additive blend and positive draw scale. Requires updated engine adapters; Unreal also requires its documented instanced RGBA material.
Cpu.Help.Rate: Produces a cumulative emitted-particle count from a rate per second. Connect Emitted total to CPU Particle. Fractional counts accumulate; repeated evaluation at the same time does not emit twice.
Cpu.Help.Burst: Each incoming Signal adds the configured fixed particle count. Connect Emitted total to CPU Particle; combine cumulative Rate and Burst values with Add.
Cpu.Help.Shape: Samples an emitter position deterministically from the system Seed and the current particle ID. Connect to Set Particle Position in Spawn. Box uses half extents, Sphere samples volume, Circle samples its XY circumference.
